people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

translations.web: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
translations.bsb: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
translations.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
translations.asv: And when they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
